question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north. Only three people sit to the left of D. B sits third to the left of D. F sits to the right of A but left of D. E sits to the right of C but left of G. How many people sit to the right of F?
solution:
Given:Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G are sitting in a row, facing the north.

 
• Only three people sit to the left of D.
 
• B sits third to the left of D.
 
• F sits to the right of A but left of D.
 
• E sits to the right of C but left of G

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d76f8d4ddd327ccd63422a26c7f0d14c3e40c333788b93f35d7c629ad10ab386.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
